# NEW 2026-11-21 v9.8 Worker 4: Religio Romana Storyline, Hexapantheon Swapper, Decisions & O(1) Pulse (oe_romp_, 0 slots, 0 rules, 0 GUI, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_romp_story.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# 1. Proclaim Religio Romana (human-only conversion decision; Mistra route or Eternal City route)
oe_romp_dec_proclaim_religio_romana = {
    decision_category = religious_decisions
    only_once = yes
    only_once_scope = country
    potential = {
        is_ai = no
        OR = {
            has_or_had_tag = BYZ
            has_or_had_tag = ROM
        }
        NOT = { religion = religion:hellenism_religion }
    }
    allow = {
        custom_tooltip = {
            text = oe_romp_human_only_tt
            is_ai = no
        }
        OR = {
            AND = {
                owns = location:constantinople
                OR = {
                    owns = location:mystras
                    owns = location:athens
                }
                OR = {
                    has_variable = oe_romp_ev2_done
                    has_variable = oe_romp_ev2_fired
                    custom_tooltip = {
                        text = oe_romp_neo_leading_tt
                        oe_ren_neo_leading = yes
                    }
                    current_year >= 1415
                }
            }
            AND = {
                owns = location:constantinople
                owns = location:athens
                owns = location:rome
            }
        }
    }
    ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
    illustration_tags = { 10 = regular 10 = interior }
    illustration_scope = { event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:clergy_estate background = estate_type:crown_estate } }
    option = {
        name = oe_romp_dec_proclaim_religio_romana.a
        effect = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    is_ai = no
                    NOT = { religion = religion:hellenism_religion }
                }
                custom_tooltip = oe_romp_dec_proclaim_religio_romana_tt
                add_stability = stability_mild_penalty
                add_estate_satisfaction = {
                    type = estate_type:clergy_estate
                    value = estate_satisfaction_severe_penalty
                }
                religion:hellenism_religion = {
                    enable_religion = yes
                    set_variable = { name = hellenism_has_omens value = 1 }
                }
                change_religion = religion:hellenism_religion
                hidden_effect = {
                    oe_romp_purge_unseated_gods = yes
                }
                ruler_or_regent ?= {
                    if = {
                        limit = { NOT = { religious_figure ?= religious_figure:cardinal } }
                        change_character_religion = religion:hellenism_religion
                    }
                    every_descendant = {
                        limit = {
                            is_alive = yes
                            owner = root
                            NOT = { religious_figure ?= religious_figure:cardinal }
                        }
                        change_character_religion = religion:hellenism_religion
                    }
                }
                heir ?= {
                    if = {
                        limit = { NOT = { religious_figure ?= religious_figure:cardinal } }
                        change_character_religion = religion:hellenism_religion
                    }
                }
                consort ?= {
                    if = {
                        limit = { NOT = { religious_figure ?= religious_figure:cardinal } }
                        change_character_religion = religion:hellenism_religion
                    }
                }
                capital = {
                    spawn_movement = {
                        movement_definition = movement_definition:hellenism_religion_movement
                        supporters = {
                            value = population
                            multiply = 0.15
                        }
                    }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_ev4_fired } }
                    set_variable = oe_romp_ev4_fired
                    trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_romp.4 days = 1 }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

# 2. Establish or Join the Collegium Pontificum (oe_romp_pontificate IO)
oe_romp_dec_found_collegium_pontificum = {
    decision_category = religious_decisions
    hide_repeatable_tag = yes
    potential = {
        religion = religion:hellenism_religion
        NOT = { is_member_of_international_organization_of_type = { type = oe_romp_pontificate } }
    }
    allow = {
        religion = religion:hellenism_religion
        stability >= -20
    }
    ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
    illustration_tags = { 10 = regular 10 = interior }
    illustration_scope = { event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:clergy_estate background = estate_type:nobles_estate } }
    option = {
        name = oe_romp_dec_found_collegium_pontificum.a
        effect = {
            custom_tooltip = oe_romp_dec_found_collegium_pontificum_tt
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { unique_international_organization_type_exists = international_organization_type:oe_romp_pontificate } }
                create_international_organization = {
                    type = international_organization_type:oe_romp_pontificate
                    add_country_to_international_organization = root
                    set_leader_country = root
                }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { NOT = { is_member_of_international_organization_of_type = { type = oe_romp_pontificate } } }
                international_organization:oe_romp_pontificate ?= {
                    add_country_to_international_organization = root
                }
            }
            add_religious_influence = religious_influence_weak_bonus
        }
    }
}

    ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
    illustration_tags = { 10 = regular 10 = exterior }
    illustration_scope = { event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:burghers_estate background = estate_type:clergy_estate } }
    option = {
        name = oe_romp_dec_restore_temple_guide.a
        effect = {
            custom_tooltip = oe_romp_dec_restore_temple_guide_tt
            trigger_event_non_silently = oe_romp_ritual.11
        }
    }
}

# 4. Toggle Liturgical Naming Style (Religio Romana vs Greco-Roman Polytheism, 1-year cooldown)
oe_romp_dec_style_toggle = {
    decision_category = religious_decisions
    hide_repeatable_tag = yes
    potential = {
        is_ai = no
        religion = religion:hellenism_religion
    }
    allow = {
        custom_tooltip = {
            text = oe_romp_style_cd_tt
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_style_toggle_cd }
        }
    }
    ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
    illustration_tags = { 10 = regular 10 = interior }
    illustration_scope = { event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:nobles_estate background = estate_type:clergy_estate } }
    option = {
        name = oe_romp_dec_style_toggle.a
        effect = {
            custom_tooltip = oe_romp_dec_style_toggle_tt
            set_variable = { name = oe_romp_style_toggle_cd months = 12 }
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_style_grecoroman }
                remove_variable = oe_romp_style_grecoroman
                set_variable = oe_romp_style_roman
            }
            else = {
                remove_variable = oe_romp_style_roman
                set_variable = oe_romp_style_grecoroman
            }
        }
    }
}
